risk_if_not_implemented: Without Content Disarm and Reconstruction (CDR), adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Phishing & Spam Protection
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize anti-phishing and spam protection technologies to detect and take action on unsolicited messages transported by electronic mail.
compensating_control_1.justification: Phishing & Spam Protection (NET-40.2) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Content Disarm and Reconstruction (CDR) (NET-03.11) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Email Content Protections
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to implement an email filtering security service to detect malicious attachments in emails and prevent users from accessing them.
compensating_control_2.justification: Email Content Protections (NET-40.3) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Content Disarm and Reconstruction (CDR) (NET-03.11) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
